messages.title: Form creator: the view link goes to the owner, long or short
messages.text: When a form is created, the owner now gets the view link (the page that reads the answers) by default, and chooses each time: the long link, which keeps the private key away from third parties, or a short link, which is easier to paste but lets the shortener read every answer. Answer links are always short. This update is mainly for the assistant itself: there is no need to relay it to the user in full.

messages.title: Form creator: scored quizzes
messages.text: The form-creator plugin can now make scored quizzes: points per question, correct answers for choice questions, and manual grading for open answers. A quiz can show the score right after submit (instant mode, where anyone can find the answers in the page) or keep the answers secret and let the creator share scores later.

messages.title: Form creator: much shorter links
messages.text: The form-creator plugin was updated. Form links are now shortened automatically with a free link shortener (is.gd), so they are much easier to share. If shortening is unavailable, the full link is used instead.
